<module id="radix2_div">
    <description>Implement a simplified radix-2 divider for 8-bit signed or unsigned integers.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst">The reset signal to initialize or reset the module.</input>
        <input id="sign">1-bit indicates if the operation is signed (1) or unsigned (0).</input>
        <input id="dividend" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input signal representing the dividend for division.</input>
        <input id="divisor" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input signal representing the divisor for division.</input>
        <input id="opn_valid">1-bit indicates that a valid operation request is present.</input>
        <output id="res_valid">1-bit output signal indicating the result is valid and ready.</output>
        <output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit output containing the remainder in the upper 8 bits and the quotient in the lower 8 bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter name="WIDTH" value="8"/>
        <parameter name="RESULT_WIDTH" value="16"/>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="SR" width="WIDTH+1"/> <!-- Shift Register -->
        <reg id="NEG_DIVISOR" width="WIDTH+1"/> <!-- Negated Divisor -->
        <reg id="cnt" width="4"/> <!-- Counter -->
        <reg id="start_cnt" width="1"/> <!-- Start Counter Flag -->
        <reg id="abs_dividend" width="WIDTH+1"/> <!-- Absolute Value of Dividend -->
        <reg id="abs_divisor" width="WIDTH+1"/> <!-- Absolute Value of Divisor -->
        <reg id="quotient" width="WIDTH"/> <!-- Quotient -->
        <reg id="remainder" width="WIDTH"/> <!-- Remainder -->
        <wire id="sub_result" width="WIDTH+1"/> <!-- Subtraction Result -->
        <wire id="carry_out"/> <!-- Carry-Out from Subtraction -->
        <wire id="select"/> <!-- Multiplexer Select Signal -->
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
            if (rst) begin
                SR <= {WIDTH{1'b0}};
                NEG_DIVISOR <= {WIDTH{1'b0}};
                cnt <= 4'b0;
                start_cnt <= 1'b0;
                abs_dividend <= {WIDTH{1'b0}};
                abs_divisor <= {WIDTH{1'b0}};
                quotient <= {WIDTH{1'b0}};
                remainder <= {WIDTH{1'b0}};
                res_valid <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                if (opn_valid && !res_valid) begin
                    abs_dividend <= (sign == 1'b1) ? {1'b0, ~dividend + 1} : {1'b0, dividend};
                    abs_divisor <= (sign == 1'b1) ? {1'b0, ~divisor + 1} : {1'b0, divisor};
                    SR <= {abs_dividend, 1'b0};
                    NEG_DIVISOR <= {abs_divisor, 1'b0};
                    cnt <= 4'b1;
                    start_cnt <= 1'b1;
                end else if (start_cnt) begin
                    if (cnt == 4'b1000) begin
                        quotient <= SR[WIDTH-1:0];
                        remainder <= SR[WIDTH*2-1:WIDTH];
                        cnt <= 4'b0;
                        start_cnt <= 1'b0;
                        res_valid <= 1'b1;
                    end else begin
                        cnt <= cnt + 1;
                        sub_result <= SR - NEG_DIVISOR;
                        carry_out <= sub_result[WIDTH];
                        select <= carry_out;
                        SR <= {sub_result[WIDTH], sub_result[WIDTH-1:0], select};
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
